title: Hojaiga Procedural Guide (video-mined or authored)
description: The contract between the ingestion pipeline (Whisper transcript + OpenCV keyframes -> 7B extraction) and the guided executor + verifier. One guide = one app workflow, as an ordered list of grounded, individually-verifiable steps.

target_url.description: Live URL or binary the guide executes against

source.description: Provenance -- where the knowledge came from (auditability).

tut_time.description: Source timestamp, e.g. '0:23' (ties step back to the video)

target.description: Live control label/id the executor grounds against (from Stage-1 scan)

selector.description: Optional concrete CSS/aria selector if known from the scan

verify.description: The oracle that PROVES the step worked -- grounded in observed DOM/UIA state, never the model's imagination.
